findings.defect: The curious prompt “and then?” is changed into the dismissive “so what?”, reversing Cheongpung’s attitude. It is also spoken dialogue, not an internal thought.
findings.rationale: 그래서요 asks what happened next in an eager, polite register; it does not express indifference or contempt.

findings.current:
A single fist that knocked down a tiger? It certainly possessed enough destructive power to justify the name. If my Toughness hadn’t been increasing rapidly every time I sparred, I would have dropped to my knees just like yesterday.

*Should I take comfort in the fact that I’m doing much better than yesterday?*

Toughness wasn’t the only thing that had improved. By experiencing Cheongpung’s martial arts with my own body, I was gradually getting used to them.
findings.defect: Capitalizing “Toughness” invents a named System stat where the source refers generically to Taekyung’s improving ability to withstand blows.
findings.rationale: 맷집 is ordinary physical durability or an ability to take hits, not a capitalized game attribute.
findings.replacement:
A single fist that knocked down a tiger? It certainly possessed enough destructive power to justify the name. If I hadn’t been getting so much better at taking hits with every duel, I would have dropped to my knees just like yesterday.

*Should I take comfort in the fact that I’m doing much better than yesterday?*

My ability to take a hit wasn’t the only thing that had improved. By experiencing Cheongpung’s martial arts with my own body, I was gradually getting used to them.
findings.source:
한 주먹에 호랑이를 쓰러트린다? 확실히 그럴 만한 파괴력을 지닌 초식이다. 비무를 겪을 때마다 쭉쭉 상승하는 맷집이 아니었다면 어제처럼 무릎을 꿇었을 것이다.

‘그래도 어제보단 많이 나아진 걸 위안 삼아야 하나?’

올라간 것은 맷집뿐만이 아니다. 청풍의 무공을 직접 몸으로 겪으면서 점점 익숙해지고 있었다.

findings.current: Was that a compliment? Getting praised by someone as talented as Cheongpung…
findings.defect: The draft omits the mocking slang register of 재능충 and turns Taekyung’s comic reaction into neutral description.
findings.rationale: 재능충 is a jocular, disparaging slang label for someone absurdly gifted, fitting Taekyung’s irreverent narration.
findings.replacement: That was a compliment, right? To think a talent freak like Cheongpung was praising me.
findings.source: 이거 칭찬 맞지? 청풍 같은 재능충에게 칭찬을 받다니.

findings.current: Of course, that was all thanks to the System.
findings.defect: The neutral phrase “thanks to” loses the self-deprecating slang force of 시스템 빨, which means that the System carried or boosted him.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly undercuts his achievement with colloquial gaming slang rather than merely crediting the System.
findings.replacement: Of course, the System had carried me through all of it.

findings.current: There had been a demonstration by the older students in the high school class, and after watching it exactly twice, I had been able to copy everything from Taegeuk Il Jang to Taegeuk Pal Jang.
findings.defect: The draft leaves all eight Korean form names in unexplained romanization, and “high school class” is an unnatural rendering of the older high-school division students.
findings.rationale: 태극 1장부터 8장 denotes the complete sequence of eight Taegeuk forms; a concise footnote preserves the cultural term while making it intelligible.
findings.replacement:
The older high school students had put on a taekwondo demonstration, and after watching it exactly twice, I could follow all eight Taegeuk forms.[^1]

[^1]: Taegeuk forms are a standardized sequence of eight color-belt patterns in taekwondo.
findings.source: 고등부 형들의 태권도 시범이 있었고, 정확히 두 번 만에 태극 1장부터 8장까지 따라 할 수 있게 됐다.

findings.current: The spearheads that had charged in while controlling every direction cut futilely through empty air.
findings.defect: The plural “spearheads” suggests multiple weapons, while “controlling every direction” is an opaque calque that obscures the single spearhead attacking from all sides.
findings.rationale: 창날 is singular, and 사방을 점하고 describes its attack covering every direction.
findings.replacement: The spearhead came at him from every direction, only to slice uselessly through empty air.
findings.source: 사방을 점하고 달려들던 창날이 허무하게 허공을 갈랐다.

findings.current: Another man was blocking every single form of the Plum Blossom Sword Technique performed by the Sword Saint’s disciple.
findings.defect: The draft adds “form,” implying that Taekyung is blocking every distinct form in the technique rather than every attack Cheongpung is currently unleashing.
findings.rationale: The source says he blocks the Plum Blossom Sword Technique in its entirety in this exchange; it does not use 초식 or state that every constituent form is demonstrated.
findings.replacement: Another man was blocking every strike of the Plum Blossom Sword Technique unleashed by the Sword Saint’s disciple.
findings.source: 검성의 제자가 펼치는 매화검법을 모조리 막아 내는 또 다른 한 사람.

findings.current: Several scars marked his exposed chest, and blood seeped freely from them.
findings.defect: “Scars” denotes healed tissue and conflicts with the fresh blood currently welling from the injuries.
findings.rationale: In context, 상흔 refers to fresh wounds just inflicted by the Heavenly Eagle Claw.
findings.replacement: Several long wounds scored his exposed chest, blood welling freely from them.
findings.source: 살이 드러난 가슴팍에는 몇 줄기의 상흔과 핏물이 흥건하게 배어 나왔다.

findings.current: His movements were instinctive, like those of a wild beast, yet he somehow maintained the form of the martial art.
findings.defect: “Somehow maintained” omits 아슬아슬하게, which establishes that his movements only barely remain recognizable as martial arts.
findings.rationale: 아슬아슬하게 emphasizes how narrowly Taekyung’s feral movement stays within formal martial structure.
findings.replacement: His movements were instinctive, like those of a wild beast, yet they barely retained the form of martial arts.
findings.source: 아슬아슬하게 무공의 형태를 지키면서도 맹수와도 같은 본능적인 움직임.

findings.current: *It isn’t a problem with his martial arts.*
findings.defect: The draft frames martial arts as a possible defect or problem, while Hyuk Mujin means that the frightening quality he perceives is not about martial skill at all.
findings.rationale: 문제가 아니야 here means “that is not the issue,” introducing the contrast between Taekyung’s current realm and his extraordinary survival instinct.

findings.current: Just a few days ago, he had not been able to endure even a hundred forms against the supreme techniques of Huashan that Cheongpung unleashed.
findings.defect: 초 here counts combat moves, not distinct martial-art forms. Calling them “a hundred forms” falsely implies that Cheongpung demonstrated a hundred separate forms.
findings.rationale: The quantified 百여 초 describes how long the exchange lasted in moves; the source does not use 초식 in this sentence.
findings.replacement: Just a few days ago, he hadn’t been able to last even a hundred moves against the supreme techniques of Huashan that Cheongpung unleashed.
findings.source: 바로 며칠 전만 하더라도 청풍이 쏟아 내는 화산파의 절기들 앞에 불과 백여 초를 버티지 못했다.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin had personally watched him endure well over three hundred forms.
findings.defect: The draft again renders the combat count 초 as distinct “forms,” changing the stated duration of the exchange into an implausible count of separate techniques.
findings.rationale: 삼백여 초 measures the number of moves exchanged, and the wording also preserves that this count covers only the portion Hyuk Mujin personally witnessed.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin alone had watched the exchange go well beyond three hundred moves.
findings.source: 혁무진이 직접 지켜본 것만 삼백여 초가 훌쩍 넘어갔다.

summary: Several actionable fidelity and terminology issues, including a reversed reaction, an invented System-like stat, lost colloquial register, and combat moves mislabeled as forms.
